Baptist Health is a not-for-profit healthcare organization seeking an Associate Software Engineer for its Technology and Digital team. The role focuses on designing and building digital healthcare capabilities that improve patient, consumer, and employee experiences while collaborating across teams and working with modern technologies and platforms.
Hospital & Health Care
H1B Sponsor Likely
Responsibilities
Designing and building next generation Healthcare digital capabilities leveraging latest technology stack and platforms
Be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward
Ability to work in large, collaborative teams to achieve organizational goals, and passionate about building an innovative culture

Required
Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science or equivalent is required
1+ years of professional software development experience
Demonstrated problem solving and debugging skills
Effective collaborator, experienced in creating technical partnerships across teams
Proficiency in at least two modern programming languages (e.g., Python, Java, TypeScript/JavaScript)
Experience working with data, including SQL, data modeling, and building or maintaining data pipelines (ETL/ELT)
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to break ambiguous, open-ended business problems into concrete technical solutions
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to work directly with non-technical stakeholders and clients
Ability to manage priorities and deliver in fast-paced, evolving environments with limited specification
Preferred
Knowledge of AWS, GCP, MS Azure or similar cloud computing platforms is a plus
Experience working in DevOps or on open-source projects is a significant plus
Benefits
Career growth and development opportunities, with clear pathways and ongoing support
Comprehensive health and wellness resources that go beyond traditional benefits
A wellness program that can help employees eliminate their medical plan deductible, reducing out-of-pocket healthcare costs
Tuition reimbursement to support continued learning and advancement
